mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_record (user_id, record_name, duration, question_count, resume, jd, evaluation, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recordName}, #{duration}, #{questionCount}, #{resume}, #{jd}, #{evaluation}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, record_name, duration, question_count, evaluation, create_time FROM interview_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_record SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE interview_record SET evaluation = #{evaluation} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT evaluation, create_time FROM interview_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
